clips.title: The story
paras: Verner Osgood, the stable master in Lakeshire, finds his business under siege by gnolls raiding south from the Redridge foothills. Already strained by Blackrock orc incursions, he asks travelers to clear out the brutes and mystics threatening his livestock.

Running a stable in Lakeshire has become increasingly hazardous. Blackrock orcs command the heights of the region, while packs of gnolls roam the surrounding ridges. For Verner Osgood, the situation reached a breaking point when aggressive gnoll raiding bands crept close to the northern borders of his paddocks, preying on any horses that wandered too close to the bluffs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough! Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...
If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My horses still seem skittish, and I still hear that cursed wolf cry at night. Please, friend, do something about those Gnolls!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for all your help, friend.
